title: An Irreversible Choice
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's declaration faded, a deep, ancient chuckle echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record—the Eye of Heavenly Dao, for the first time, truly regarded this piece on the board.

text.content:
Trembling.

The moment Mo Xiansheng spoke Su Qingyao's true name, the halo suspended above the Tianji Record Fragment violently shook, as if some ancient colossus was tearing at this barrier from outside.

Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, and fine cracks appeared on the verdigris cover of the Tianji Record in his palm. He sensed it—that was the aura of the Xuanwu Sect's sect-protecting formation, the 'Xuanming Suoyuan Formation.'

That brute Han Lie, daring to pursue here?

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly became urgent)

'Bad—this is the formation-breaking incantation of Xuanming Suoyuan! This formation specializes in countering spatial divine abilities. Once breached, the secrets of the Tianji Record will be exposed before all under heaven!'

(A cold light flickered across Chen Ji's eyes, yet his expression held no panic)

'He comes quickly. That fool Han Lie probably thinks brute force alone can pry open the Tianji Record?'

He raised his hand to press against the cracks on the cover, golden Spiritual Energy seeping from his fingertips, forcibly resisting the formation's corrosive intent.

text.content:
The external tremors grew increasingly violent.

Through the shattered barrier, Chen Ji witnessed a scene that would shatter ordinary people's courage—Han Lie stood bare-chested, black-scaled patterns writhing across his body like living things, both palms pressed against a black formation screen, each strike carrying the force to shake mountains and rivers.

At the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, several Elders joined forces to cast techniques, yet they were forced to retreat repeatedly by that brutal strength.

And Su Qingyao stood at the formation's core,苦苦支撑 with all her Inner Sect Senior Fellow power.

dialogue.content:
(Su Qingyao's voice pierced through the formation into the Tianji Record space)

'Chen Ji! What are you doing! Han Lie has gone mad—he says he will refine you and this evil object before all three sects!'

Her tone carried a hint of unprecedented anxiety.

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart tightened suddenly.

He saw blood seeping from Su Qingyao's brow—that was the price of forcibly invoking forbidden arts. She could have retreated, yet she chose to protect the formation with her own body.

This discovery made his pupils contract sharply.

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then spoke: 'Boy, the Tianji Record has already deduced three methods for you to escape. If you wish to protect her, you only need to—'

'Unnecessary.' Chen Ji interrupted him, his voice cold as millennia-old ice.

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng was难得 silent for a breath)

'...What do you intend to do?'

(Chen Ji suddenly lifted his head, golden light flashing in his eyes, the Tianji Record's pages fluttering wildly)

'Mo Xiansheng, you said all prophets throughout history are merely pieces on Heaven's chessboard. Then let me ask you—'

His voice suddenly rose, carrying unprecedented arrogance.

'Does a piece have the right to overturn the chessboard?'

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, as if this words had struck some ancient wound.

After a long while, he let out a desolate laugh: 'Good... good for overturning the chessboard! This old man has waited three thousand years to hear these words!'

The Tianji Record's light suddenly surged, the cracks on the verdigris cover began healing, replaced by golden inscriptions emerging one after another.

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng's voice carried determination)

'Boy, this old man will pass you one more volume of Tianji Secret Interpretation. This volume is not among the fragments—it is formed from my ten-thousand-year remnant soul—the price is this old man will completely dissipate.'

'But before that, I will buy you three breaths of time. Within those three breaths, you must make your choice.'

text.content:
Before the words even finished, dramatic changes occurred in the world beyond the Tianji Record.

Han Lie's Xuanming Suoyuan Formation was finally broken open a crack, and he charged in laughing wildly—yet what greeted him was a brilliant sword light.

Su Qingyao, with her heavily wounded body, actually blocked him head-on.

'Su Qingyao!' Han Lie roared, 'You've gone mad! For a waste—'

'He is a person of the Tianqing Sect.' Su Qingyao's voice was cold as ice, 'You Xuanwu Sect have no right to handle him.'

choice.prompt: Three breaths had elapsed. The power of the Tianji Record was awakening, and the conflict between Xuanwu Sect and Tianqing Sect was on the verge of erupting. At this moment, Chen Ji must make his choice—

choices.description: Use no faction resources, strike Han Lie head-on with the power of the Tianji Record, and declare to all: My fate, Chen Ji, is written by myself.
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record Volume Two Unsealed, Combat Power Soaring
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's combat power is overwhelming; head-on confrontation carries extreme risk

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He suddenly raised the Tianji Record above his head, lowing: 'Volume Two, unseal!' In an instant, the Tianji Record blazed with golden light, fragments flew, countless golden inscriptions emerged around him—this was the true power of the Tianji Record, sufficient to shake heaven and earth.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record as a medium to transmit information to Ye Qing far away in the Demonic Path, cover his tracks with the Demonic Path's mists, and escape in the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the fact of colluding with the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao will completely see Chen Ji's true colors

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertips condensed a jet-black rune—that was the communication mark Ye Qing had left him. Once activated, demonic path mist would descend from the heavens, completely shrouding the aura of the Tianji Record. The cost: everyone present would see that he had connections with the demonic path.

choices.description: Utilize the power of the Tianji Record, simultaneously showing prophecies to everyone present—letting all witness their most feared future, using this as leverage to gain negotiating capital.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate, triggering the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire arena, gain absolute negotiating dominance
choices.risk_hint: Expose the true abilities of the Tianji Record, attracting the covetousness of greater powers

text.content: Chen Ji inhaled deeply—the cost of unsealing the second volume of the Tianji Record far exceeded imagination—but he had no retreat. At this moment, he wanted to declare to all powers: Chen Ji is no longer anyone's chess piece.

Chen Ji's choice has been made.

The golden inscriptions of the Tianji Record's second volume slowly condensed in the air, transforming into a dazzling galaxy—a sign of the Tianji Record's true awakening.

Han Lie and Su Qingyao's battle ceased abruptly. Everyone's gaze was captured by that golden light.

And from the depths of the Tianji Record, a sound beyond human comprehension echoed—the first gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm)

「Han Lie, do you think breaking through the formation means you're certain of victory?」

He stepped slowly out of the Tianji Record's protective range, facing that arrogant figure.

「Today, I, Chen Ji, will show you—what true power really means.」

choice.prompt: The moment the second volume unsealed, Chen Ji sensed a dramatic shift in destiny. The Heavenly Dao's Eye was watching, and the Tianji Record's true secrets were about to be exposed—at this moment he must make a choice:

choices.description: Before everyone, use the Tianji Record to display Han Lie's most feared future—the image of himself being defeated by Chen Ji three months later.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze deepens
choices.visible_reward: Publicly humiliate Han Lie, become renowned across the Three Sects
choices.risk_hint: Displaying power will attract more forces to covet

dialogue.content: Han Lie's expression dramatically transformed. He witnessed his most unwillingly acknowledged future—at that moment, his Dao heart wavered, and the dark scaled patterns across his entire body began to dim.

choices.description: Only utilize a portion of the second volume's power, defeating Han Lie with absolute碾压 domination, without exposing the Tianji Record's complete secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Combat power consumption, unable to intimidate other forces
choices.visible_reward: Maintain mystery, letting enemies continue to underestimate
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze will not be weakened

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the Tianji Record's unusual phenomena, only using pure spiritual energy to suppress Han Lie. At this moment, he still appeared to be thattrash disciple—until Han Lie's attack was effortlessly deflected by a burst of golden light.

The Tianji Record's radiance enveloped the entire Tianqing Sect.

Everyone felt that majestic power—a presence that transcended their comprehension. Han Lie's complexion turned ashen, his Dao heart cracking at this moment.

Su Qingyao stared blankly at the formertrash disciple before her, disbelief filling her eyes.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was dissipating, yet his laughter echoed through the entire space: 「Good... excellent! This old man waited three thousand years for someone daring enough to make a move against the heavens!」

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold and sharp, addressing the void, as if declaring to some unseen presence)

「Heavenly Dao's Eye, I know you're watching.」

He raised his head, his gaze直视 the无形注视 from the depths of the heavens.

「From today onward, my fate, Chen Ji's fate, is written by myself. If you wish to once again use me as a chess piece—」

A mocking curve crept onto his lips.

「Then I shall first overturn this chessboard.」

text.content:
With these words, the heavens and earth transformed.

The originally clear sky suddenly darkened, with rolling thunderclouds gathering above the Tianqing Sect. That was heaven's warning—and also a sign of the Heavenly Dao's Eye's fury.

Yet Chen Ji was utterly unafraid.

He slowly turned, looking at the shocked Su Qingyao, his voice suddenly softening: 「Senior Sister Su, you have thrice come infinitely close to the truth.」

「Now, I give you one final opportunity.」

dialogue.content:
(Su Qingyao's eyes reddened slightly, her lips trembling)

"You... who exactly are you?"

"That waste servant... that Chen Ji who was bullied by everyone... was all of this false?"

(Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then let out a light laugh)

"Not entirely false."

He raised his hand, gazing at the Tianji Record inscriptions slowly rotating in his palm.

"That waste Chen Ji was real. Being stepped on by you, mocked by you, treated as an ant—all of it was real."

"But..."

He lifted his head, golden light swirling in his eyes.

"Even an ant can overturn the chessboard one day."

text.content:
Su Qingyao stared at him blankly. At this moment, she suddenly understood why she had been drawn to this person again and again.

It wasn't the aura of atrash—a waste. It was the predatory instinct of a枭雄—a hegemon—swallowing all humiliation, waiting for the perfect moment to deliver a fatal strike.

Han Lie roared in the distance, but his voice had been suppressed by the Tianji Record's power until it was barely audible.

Ling Yuan's figure appeared at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. He watched from afar, his murky eyes flickering with a hint of wariness.

And Ye Qing from the Demonic Path Holy Sect, who was watching everything through some secret technique, had a meaningful smile curve at the corner of her lips.

dialogue.content:
(Deep within the Tianji Record, that transcendent consciousness finally spoke—not with words, but with a pressure that directly assaulted Chen Ji's soul)

"Three thousand years, and another ant who dares to challenge the Heavenly Way."

"Do you know the price?"

(Chen Ji laughed long and hard toward the sky, his laughter echoing between heaven and earth)

"Price?"

He gripped the Tianji Record in his palm, golden inscriptions spreading up his arm.

"From the day I stepped onto the cultivation path, I never intended to meet a peaceful end."

"If you want war, then let's war!"

choice.prompt: The pressure from the Heavenly Eye intensified, and the choice of fate descended once more. Chen Ji had to make the final decision—

choices.description: Using the second volume of the Tianji Record's power, directly confront the Heavenly Eye's pressure and declare independence.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 25 Heavenly Fate points; Tianji Record enters cooldown
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from Heavenly control and gain independent status
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will drop to dangerous levels; the body will endure extreme pressure

text.content: The Tianji Record erupted with world-shocking brilliance—a power directly confronting Heavenly Will. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining frantically, but he smiled—from this moment on, he was no longer anyone's chess piece.

choices.description: Instead of directly resisting the Heavenly Eye, use this chaos to display the Tianji Record's prophetic abilities to all forces, trading intelligence for a temporary alliance.
choices.visible_reward: Gain temporary alliance of multiple forces; preserve strength
choices.risk_hint: Various forces will covet the Tianji Record even more, creating endless future troubles

text.content: Chen Ji scanned his surroundings and spoke to Ling Yuan, Han Lie, and the various forces watching from the shadows: "Isn't everyone here seeking the secrets of the Tianji Record? I can tell you—but first, you need to give me a position where I can speak standing up."

The final choice had been made.

Chen Ji stood within the golden light condensed by the Tianji Record, overlooking the countless mortals below. Han Lie was suppressed and unable to move, Su Qingyao was filled with shock, Ling Yuan lurked in the shadows with hidden ambitions, and the Heavenly Eye's pressure pressed down like Mount Tai.

At this moment, Chen Ji finally laid all his cards on the table.

He no longer pretended, no longer endured, no longer was that waste servant trampled by all.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's voice pierced through nine heavens, spreading across the entire Tianqing Sect)

"From this day forward, I, Chen Ji, make this oath here—"

"My fate, I shall write myself!"

"My enemies, I shall destroy myself!"

"My path, I shall walk myself!"

He raised the Tianji Record high, golden light breaking through the dark clouds and shooting straight into the heavens.

"If Heaven blocks my path, I shall rebel against Heaven!"

text.content:
Once these words were spoken, a deathly silence fell over heaven and earth.

No one dared to believe that the waste servant once trampled by all would dare to make such an oath against Heaven in public.

A sinister glint flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes. He realized this young man's threat had exceeded his control.

Han Lie, pressed down by the golden light, trembled all over, but he still roared with all his might: "Chen Ji! Who do you think you are! Under Heaven, you are merely an ant!"

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji lowered his gaze to Han Lie, a mocking curve appearing at the corner of his lips)

"An ant?"

He walked slowly to Han Lie, speaking word by word: "In three months, I will let you know how long it takes to crush an ant."

"And before that—"

He suddenly raised his palm, a golden rune imprinting itself on Han Lie's forehead.

"Get lost and return to the Xuanwu Sect. Tell your Sect Master—the master of the Tianji Record, has arrived."

text.content:
The words fell, and golden light surged.

Han Lie felt an irresistible force sweep him entire body skyward, streaking across the long void until he disappeared beyond the horizon.

The堂堂 Xuanwu Sect's number one genius,就这样被打一个曾经被公认的trash一掌拍飞。

The entire Tianqing Sect fell into absolute silence.

dialogue.content:
(Su Qingyao walked slowly toward Chen Ji, her eyes filled with complex, indecipherable emotions)

"Chen Ji... no, what should I call you?"

Her voice carried a tremor: "These three years... was everything between us and you a calculation?"

(Chen Ji turned around, looking at Su Qingyao, a rare hint of gentleness appearing in his eyes)

"Calculation?"

He fell silent for a moment, then shook his head: "At first, it was."

"But later..."

He lifted his head,直视 Su Qingyao's eyes: "Later, when you blocked that sword for me, I didn't know whether to count you in."

text.content: Su Qingyao froze. She remembered that time in the secret realm when she had taken the fatal blow for Chen Ji despite her serious injuries. Back then, she had only thought it was a momentary impulse, an instinct of being the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. So in his eyes, that was something beyond calculation. "You..." She didn't know what to say, only feeling her eyes grow hot.

Chen Ji did not say more. He turned to look at the elders of Tianqing Sect, his voice returning to its usual calm. "Elders, regarding today's events, Chen Ji will give the sect an explanation." "But before that—" He raised his head again, looking at the still gloomy sky, at that gaze that could not be seen yet could be sensed. "I need to handle some matters alone."

The Tianji Record slowly rotated in his palm, the golden inscriptions from the second volume after unsealing reflected on his face, making his expression appear infinitely profound. Mo Xiansheng's voice had completely dissipated, leaving only his final words echoing in his Mental Sea: "Boy, I've done everything I could. The road ahead, you must walk alone." "Remember—the true secret of the Tianji Record lies not in power, but in choice." "Every choice is rewriting destiny."

Chen Ji stood quietly in place, allowing the golden light of the Tianji Record to extend his figure into something infinitely majestic. He thought of his missing sister Chen Nian—that existence he regarded as his greatest weakness. He thought of Su Qingyao—that woman who had approached the truth several times yet had it dissolved. He thought of Ye Qing, Ling Yuan, Han Lie... And that Heavenly Eye that had always loomed above him. From today onward, all these entanglements would meet their end.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, stepping out of the Tianji Record's protective range, facing the gaze from the Heavenly Dao. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread across the Three Realms: "From now on, I, Chen Ji, will no longer hide, no longer disguise myself, no longer be anyone's chess piece." "If heaven wants to destroy me, I shall defy heaven." "If people want to kill me, I shall slaughter people." "This is Chen Ji's Declaration of Independence—and my declaration of war against the Heavenly Eye."

The Tianji Record shuddered violently, the golden inscriptions on its bronze-green cover flashing frantically. In this moment, everyone felt it—the Tianji Record was undergoing some unimaginable change. And beyond the Three Realms, that Heavenly Dao will that had always watched the mortal world, for the first time, developed genuine interest in this former chess piece. Not anger, but curiosity. How far could an ant daring to challenge heaven actually go?
